Code agents—AI systems capable of generating, executing, and iteratively refining code—have emerged as transformative tools in software engineering. Code agents—AI systems capable of generating, executing, and iteratively refining code—have emerged as transformative tools in software engineering. Powered by large language models (LLMs) with advanced code generation capabilities, these agents can handle complex programming tasks, debug errors, and even execute code in isolated environments. 4. **Jailbreaking Resistance**: Evaluating defenses against attempts to bypass safety constraints.
